title: A drawn character becomes a 3D figure
pitch: A character design in. A textured mesh at the size of a desk figure, with a turntable, out.
why: Anima draws a clean front view in one style, TRELLIS.2 reads it into a textured mesh, and Blender gives it a real size, a base and a turntable.

models.name: Anima
models.note: Non-commercial: this whole result can't be sold while it contains Anima frames.

models.name: Blender
models.licence: GPL, runs as a separate tool

tips: A plain background and the whole figure in frame make a cleaner mesh.

steps.label: The design
steps.prompt: full body character design of a small round robot postman with a canvas satchel and a peaked cap, standing, front view, whole figure in frame, plain white background

steps.label: Textured mesh
steps.does: Cuts the object out and builds a textured mesh from one picture.

steps.label: Desk figure
steps.does: Real size, pivot at the base, a collider and a turntable, in Blender.
